title: Cancelling a Rental Vehicle Coordination Reservation
content:
**Rule.** A Rental Vehicle Coordination reservation may be cancelled at any time before pickup without charge, by the customer or because the repair it was for was withdrawn or declared a total loss before pickup. Covered days authorized on a cancelled reservation lapse unused. A rental already picked up is never cancelled; it is returned and settled.

## Points of judgement

| Reservation status | Cancellation |
|---|---|
| Reserved (before pickup) | May be cancelled, without charge |
| On rent (picked up) | Never cancelled; returned and settled |

- **Who or what may bring it about before pickup**: the customer, or the withdrawal of the repair, or the repair being declared a total loss before pickup.
- **Covered days already authorized**: they lapse unused on the cancelled reservation.

## Hypothetical cases

- A repair declared a total loss two days before the planned pickup: the reservation may be cancelled without charge, and any covered days authorized on it lapse unused.
- A customer whose rental was picked up yesterday no longer needs it: the rental is not cancelled; it is returned and settled.
